raw_record.question_text: Peter rides his bike along a cycle path in a park. He starts at point S and rides in the direction of the arrow. At the first crossing he turns right, then at the next left, and then again to the right and then again to left. Which crossing does he not reach?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a cycle-path graph: S lies on the right outer loop, and the arrow shows Peter initially travels upward toward the upper-right crossing B. Then trace locally at each crossing using Peter’s current facing direction. From S he first reaches B; turning right there sends him around the top loop through E toward C. At C, a left turn sends him along the top horizontal path back toward B. At B, the next right turn sends him down the right vertical path to A. At A, the next left turn keeps him on the right-side loop rather than toward the lower-left part of the diagram. Thus the labelled crossing he does not reach is D.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一条黄色自行车道网络，中间像一个矩形，四周各有环形弯道。右侧外环中部标有起点 S，旁边箭头显示彼得从 S 沿右侧外环向上骑行。右上交叉口标为 B，右下交叉口标为 A，左上交叉口标为 C，左下交叉口标为 D，顶部弯道附近标为 E。

推理：按照图中箭头，彼得从 S 先沿右侧外环向上，到达的第一个交叉口是 B。在 B 按规则第一次右转，路线进入上方环形弯道，经过顶部 E 附近并到达 C。在 C 按规则第二次左转，沿上方水平路线回到 B。在 B 按规则第三次右转，沿右侧竖直路线向下到达 A。在 A 按规则第四次左转，会进入右侧外环，而不是去往左下部分。因此他到达了 B、E、C、A，但没有到达 D。
